scope: Public primary-source review for three bilingual features. No production access, exploit execution or hardware benchmark.

prerequisites: attacker-controlled HTTP exchange or malicious mirror/proxy
apt.update_sequence: Refresh lists successfully, then review and install the upgrade with Acquire::Retries=0 for that invocation; recheck installed apt-source packages.
apt.limits: Source version thresholds require exact distributor/release mapping. HTTPS protects the path, not a malicious endpoint. Page does not inspect visitor machines.

earlier_end_of_analysis_snapshot.limits: Researcher-reported states after ten days; not a current distro-package inventory or proven disjoint sets.

adapted_kernelctf.limits: Separate experiment and cost basis. SLAB_VIRTUAL omitted for incompatibility. Bounty valuation hypothetical, not program acceptance.

kernel_ai.limits: Attributed researcher claims, not independently reproduced by the blog. No exhaustive public mapping of all groups to released distro packages verified.

plasma.change: Plasma 6.8 retires its X11 login session; XWayland and KDE application X11 compatibility continue.
plasma.limits: Repository snapshot only. Driver, KWin, XWayland, portal and application support need local verification. No claim that Cthulhu runs Plasma 6.8.
